notes: TIPO covers three patent right-types under one office: invention (20-yr term), utility model (10-yr term), and design (15-yr term). Annuity rows are expanded per-year, and the small-tier discount (natural persons / schools / SMEs) is emitted as a sibling row for the three years where it applies (1-3, 4-6, plus design 1-3 which goes to NT$0). Non-annuity rows are emitted at EntityTier.none since the schedule does not publish a small-tier discount for procedural fees.
